recommendation: Supervised soft launch; full public launch still needs actual payment and inbox acceptance checks for each enabled method.
fixes: Authoritative cancellation status survives replay and interrupted uploads.
Replay reconciles an interrupted duplicate decision without rerunning OCR.
Duplicate identities use provider and secondary reference namespaces; ambiguous or unreadable evidence stays pending.
Cancellation email outbox has an authenticated independent every-minute scheduler.
limits: Receipt verification inspects images and cannot independently confirm bank settlement.
Actual end-to-end payments and inbox delivery were not tested for every enabled method.
No new real bookings, payments or customer emails were created during this audit.
